root_cause: Walkback's ordinary cycle called create_event_ledger.retry_pending_writes, which recursively invoked ensure_schema and executed CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS under the authoritative operations writer lane. The same cycle called anchor reconciliation with an unbounded waiting-row inventory and schema ensures, allowing one transaction to span the historical population. Live owner metadata captured the recurring DDL and self-owned holds over the UI stall threshold.

repair.runtime_ddl: Recurring Walkback calls explicitly use schema-current mode. Read-only startup validators cover the anchor-reconciliation and create-ledger contracts. Standalone/default callers retain existing ensure-schema behavior.
repair.writer_scope: Recurring anchor reconciliation is deterministically limited to one oldest waiting row per cycle rather than all retained rows. Live pre-soak trials rejected 25 rows (12-20s holds) and 5 rows (19s hold). A one-row trial isolated a separate 19s post-batch promotion hold: promote_recurring_funders wrote one candidate, then classified later candidates before its final commit. The repair now commits each promotion before any later candidate classification or RPC.
repair.unchanged: Queue ordering within the selected cohort, retry semantics, attribution, provider behavior, SQLite settings, WAL behavior, timeouts, and other services are unchanged.

new_proofs: recurring retry path cannot call ensure_schema
recurring anchor path cannot call either schema ensure
recurring anchor inventory selects exactly the single oldest row
each recurring-funder promotion commits before the next candidate classification

deployment_scope.observation: Verify zero recurring CREATE statements from Walkback, bounded writer holds, natural Walkback/Cascade progress, and no new SQLite lock failures before resetting the four-hour stabilization clock.

deployment.source_preservation: The three qualified modules were staged only for process import; after restart the dirty production checkout was restored byte-for-byte to its recorded hashes. No unrelated dirty source was activated or overwritten.
rejected_live_trials: 1-row bound before promotion repair, PID 26674: post-batch promotion hold reached 19.3s
deployment.final_pre_soak: PID 28968 remained stable for 367s. Across 65 five-second samples the shared writer lane was free in every sample. Seven natural empty-queue cycles completed; recurring CREATE statements=0; new SQLITE_BUSY/database-locked/CrossProcessDatabaseWriteTimeout/Traceback events=0; UI stall messages=0. Nonempty-batch behavior remains a required gate in the four-hour natural-traffic observation.
deployment.unrelated_services: Cascade 79750, listener 93379, funding 59094, Monitor 5022, API 25464, alert 5447, creator resolution 20081 and ngrok 5454 remained unchanged.
